# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For the caption generator, the user wants continuous one-word captions within a spoken phrase: hold each word until the next starts, without blank gaps between words. The user rejected the forced-alignment experiment because it introduced such gaps.

## General Guidelines
- Avoid creating extra Markdown documentation files unless requested.
- The user cannot transfer ZIP archives from the work laptop; for CapCut tests, provide a script that runs on the personal laptop using its existing local project instead.
